f.title: Apply Annex III together with Annexes I, II, IV and V and other ANMAT rules and guidance
f.statement: Annex III must be applied together with Annex I (ICH E6 R3 GCP guideline, Spanish version), Annex II (local GCP requirements), Annex IV (GCP inspections) and Annex V (Phase I trials and first-in-human centre authorisation inspections) of the disposition and with other specific ANMAT rules, guidelines, instructions and/or guides.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Este anexo deberá aplicarse en forma conjunta con el anexo I GUÍA ICH E6 R3 DE BUENAS PRÁCTICAS CLÍNICAS (VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL), el anexo II REQUISITOS LOCALES DE BUENAS PRÁCTICAS CLÍNICAS DE ESTUDIOS DE FARMACOLOGÍA CLÍNICA CON FINES REGISTRALES, el anexo IV INSPECCIONES DE BUENAS PRÁCTICAS CLÍNICAS (BPC) DE ESTUDIOS DE FARMACOLOGÍA CLÍNICA y el anexo V REQUISITOS PARA LLEVAR A CABO ENSAYOS CLÍNICOS DE FASE I E INSPECCIONES DE AUTORIZACIÓN DE CENTRO DE FASE I DE PRIMERA VEZ EN HUMANOS de la presente norma y otras normas, lineamientos, instructivos y/o guías específicas emitidas por la ANMAT.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberá aplicarse' = Mandatory; framing provision. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberá aplicarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: framing provision, passive, actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: This annex shall be applied together with Annex I ICH E6 R3 GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINE (SPANISH VERSION), Annex II LOCAL GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE REQUIREMENTS FOR CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY STUDIES FOR REGISTRATION PURPOSES, Annex IV GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE (GCP) INSPECTIONS OF CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY STUDIES and Annex V REQUIREMENTS FOR CONDUCTING PHASE I CLINICAL TRIALS AND AUTHORISATION INSPECTIONS OF FIRST-IN-HUMAN PHASE I CENTRES of this rule, and other specific rules, guidelines, instructions and/or guides issued by ANMAT.

f.title: Obtain CRI/CEI and ANMAT approval of substantial amendments before implementation, unless urgently needed for participant safety
f.statement: Substantial protocol amendments require approval by the CRI/CEI (ethics committee) and by ANMAT before implementation, unless they must be implemented immediately to protect participant safety. Administrative protocol amendments must be attached to the next periodic report.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.exceptions: Amendments that must be implemented immediately to protect participant safety need not await prior approval.

rows.quote: 3.2 Las enmiendas sustanciales al protocolo requieren de la aprobación del CRI/CEI y de la ANMAT antes de su implementación a menos que existiera la necesidad de implementarlas de inmediato para proteger la seguridad de los participantes. Las enmiendas al protocolo de tipo administrativo deberán adjuntarse en el siguiente informe periódico.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'requieren'/'deberán adjuntarse' = Mandatory; urgent-safety exception kept. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "requieren"/"deberán adjuntarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 3.2 Substantial protocol amendments require the approval of the CRI/CEI and of ANMAT before their implementation, unless there is a need to implement them immediately to protect the safety of the participants. Administrative protocol amendments shall be attached to the next periodic report.

f.title: Submit each new Investigator's Brochure (MPI) version to ANMAT as soon as available
f.statement: The new version of the investigational product monograph (MPI, Investigator's Brochure) must be submitted to ANMAT as soon as it is available, in line with the documentation requirements of Appendix E. A single updated MPI is accepted for all studies of the same product.
f.clause: 4. Actualización de monografía del producto en investigación (MPI), 4.1-4.2
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: As soon as the new version is available
rows.quote: 4.1 La nueva versión de la MPI deberá ser presentada a la ANMAT en cuanto esté disponible. Se aceptará una sola MPI actualizada para todos los estudios del mismo producto. 4.2 La nueva versión de MPI deberá ser presentada acorde a los requisitos de documentación de presentación de MPI (ver apéndice E).
rows.location: 4. Actualización de monografía del producto en investigación (MPI), 4.1-4.2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberá ser presentada" = Mandatory, deadline "en cuanto esté disponible" explicit. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 4.1 The new version of the MPI shall be submitted to ANMAT as soon as it is available. A single updated MPI will be accepted for all studies of the same product. 4.2 The new version of the MPI shall be submitted in accordance with the documentation requirements for submission of the MPI (see Appendix E).

f.title: Scope of SUSARs: may relate to the new IMP, a product for new indications or the comparator
f.statement: Suspected unexpected serious adverse drug reactions (RAMSIS/SUSARs) may be associated with the new investigational product, with a product for new indications, or with the product used as comparator in a clinical trial.
f.clause: 5.1 Reacciones adversas medicamentosas serias inesperadas sospechadas (RAMSIS/SUSAR), 5.1.1
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Submission operations; Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: 5.1.1 Las reacciones adversas medicamentosas serias inesperadas sospechadas (RAMSIS/SUSAR) pueden estar asociadas al nuevo producto en investigación o a un producto para nuevas indicaciones o relacionadas al producto que se usa como comparador en un ensayo clínico.
rows.location: 5.1 Reacciones adversas medicamentosas serias inesperadas sospechadas (RAMSIS/SUSAR), 5.1.1
rows.review_note: Review: title reworded (source is descriptive, 'pueden estar asociadas' = may be associated); kept as a binding scope definition of which SUSARs must be reported (incl. comparator), Mandatory per GUIDE definitions rule. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Below 90: descriptive definition ("pueden estar asociadas") with no modal verb; Mandatory only as a binding scope definition (judgement call); actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.1 Suspected unexpected serious adverse drug reactions (RAMSIS/SUSAR) may be associated with the new investigational product or with a product for new indications, or related to the product used as comparator in a clinical trial.

f.title: Notify all SUSARs to investigators within time frames matching the urgency of the action required
f.statement: The sponsor must notify all SUSARs to the investigators within time frames in line with the urgency of the action required.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: Within time frames in line with the urgency of the action required
rows.quote: 5.1.2 El patrocinador deberá realizar la notificación de todas las RAMSIS/SUSAR a los investigadores en plazos acordes a la urgencia de la acción requerida.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "El patrocinador deberá realizar la notificación" gives level and actor; time frame is as stated in the quote; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.2 The sponsor shall notify all RAMSIS/SUSARs to the investigators within time frames in line with the urgency of the action required.

f.title: Promptly notify investigators of findings that may adversely affect subject safety or change the IMP safety profile
f.statement: The sponsor must also promptly notify findings that may adversely affect the safety of subjects and/or change the safety profile of the investigational product.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Asimismo, deberá notificar con celeridad sobre los hallazgos que puedan afectar negativamente la seguridad de los sujetos y/o generen cambios en el perfil de seguridad del producto en investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberá notificar con celeridad" = Mandatory, "promptly" faithful. Below 90: quote lacks its lead-in subject (sponsor named in the previous sentence), so the actor is taken from context.
rows.quote_en: Likewise, it shall promptly notify findings that may adversely affect the safety of the subjects and/or generate changes in the safety profile of the investigational product.

f.title: Investigator notification may use SUSAR line listings and/or letters with an updated benefit-risk evaluation and risk mitigation measures
f.statement: The notification to investigators may be made by SUSAR line listings and/or letters to investigators, among other means, which in a practical and concise way include an updated benefit-risk evaluation and risk mitigation measures.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Esta notificación podrá realizarse mediante lista de RAMSIS/SUSAR y/o cartas a los investigadores, entre otros, que de forma práctica y concisa incluyan una evaluación actualizada de la relación beneficio-riesgo y medidas de mitigación de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'podrá realizarse' = Permitted. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "podrá realizarse" = Permitted. Below 90: actor implied by "Esta notificación" (lead-in in previous sentence).
rows.quote_en: This notification may be made by means of a list of RAMSIS/SUSARs and/or letters to investigators, among others, which in a practical and concise way include an updated evaluation of the benefit-risk relationship and risk mitigation measures.

f.title: Report SUSARs and other safety information to the ethics committee (CRI/CEI) within the committee's time frames
f.statement: The investigator, or the sponsor where the jurisdiction's regulation so provides, must report SUSARs and all other safety information received to the relevant CRI/CEI within the time frames set by that committee.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Investigator, or sponsor where the jurisdiction's regulation so provides
rows.deadline: Within the time frames set by the CRI/CEI
rows.quote: 5.1.3 El investigador, o el patrocinador según lo establezca la regulación de la jurisdicción, deberá informar las RAMSIS/SUSAR y toda otra información de seguridad recibida al CRI/CEI correspondiente en los plazos que éste haya establecido.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; actor correctly investigator or sponsor per jurisdiction. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberá informar" = Mandatory; actor (investigator, or sponsor per jurisdiction) and time frame (set by the CRI/CEI) explicit in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.3 The investigator, or the sponsor as established by the regulation of the jurisdiction, shall report the RAMSIS/SUSARs and all other safety information received to the corresponding CRI/CEI within the time frames it has established.

f.title: Report SUSARs occurring in Argentina through ANMAT's National Pharmacovigilance System electronic reporting system
f.statement: The sponsor must notify SUSARs occurring in Argentina through the electronic notification system, in accordance with the current rules of ANMAT's National Pharmacovigilance System.
f.applicability: SUSARs occurring in Argentina in clinical pharmacology studies authorised by ANMAT. Original language Spanish.
f.systems: ANMAT electronic notification system (Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia)
f.processes: Submission operations; E2B / transmission; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: 5.1.4 El patrocinador deberá realizar la notificación de las RAMSIS/SUSAR ocurridas en Argentina a través del sistema de notificación electrónica conforme a la normativa vigente del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia de ANMAT.
systems: ANMAT electronic notification system (Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "El patrocinador deberá realizar la notificación" gives level and actor; route (electronic notification system) explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.4 The sponsor shall notify the RAMSIS/SUSARs occurring in Argentina through the electronic notification system in accordance with the current rules of the ANMAT National Pharmacovigilance System.

f.title: Send SUSAR notifications individually, complete per the electronic form and ICH E2A
f.statement: SUSAR notifications must be sent individually and contain all the information requested in the electronic notification form, in accordance with ICH E2A and its updates.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.systems: ICH E2A; ANMAT electronic notification form

rows.quote: 5.1.5 Las notificaciones de RAMSIS/SUSAR deberán enviarse de forma individualizada y contener toda la información solicitada en el formulario de notificación electrónica y conforme a lo establecido en la Guía ICH E2A y sus actualizaciones.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; source numbers two consecutive paragraphs 5.1.5 and 5.1.6 twice, the '(first)/(second)' locations are correct. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberán enviarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.5 RAMSIS/SUSAR notifications shall be sent individually and contain all the information requested in the electronic notification form and in accordance with the ICH E2A Guideline and its updates.

f.title: Report SUSARs independently of IB updates, amendments and safety reports
f.statement: SUSAR notification must be made independently of the submission of the investigator's brochure and its updates, amendments and safety reports, as detailed in the corresponding points of Annex III.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Submission operations; Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: 5.1.6 La notificación de RAMSIS/SUSAR debe realizarse independientemente de la presentación del manual de investigador y sus actualizaciones, enmiendas e informes de seguridad tal como se detalla en los puntos correspondientes del presente anexo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "debe realizarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.6 RAMSIS/SUSAR notification shall be made independently of the submission of the investigator's brochure and its updates, amendments and safety reports, as detailed in the corresponding points of this annex.

f.title: Report foreign safety information, including SUSARs, only when it changes the benefit-risk profile, within 10 business days
f.statement: Safety information, including SUSARs, from other countries where the product is being developed must be reported (to ANMAT) only when it implies a change in the benefit-risk profile, within ten (10) administrative business days of becoming aware of it.
f.applicability: Safety information (including SUSARs) from other countries where the investigational product is being developed. Original language Spanish.
f.exceptions: Only when the information implies a change in the benefit-risk profile.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.deadline: 10 administrative business days from becoming aware
rows.quote: 5.1.5 La información de seguridad, incluidas las RAMSIS/SUSAR, proveniente de otros países donde se esté desarrollando el producto deberá informarse sólo cuando implica un cambio en el perfil beneficio-riesgo dentro del plazo de diez (10) días hábiles administrativos a partir de haber tomado conocimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: statement clarified that the recipient is ANMAT (implied by 'esta Administración' context and F.1.3 expedited report). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; 10 administrative business days from awareness checked. Below 90: passive "deberá informarse", actor inferred, and the recipient (ANMAT) is added from context rather than stated in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.5 Safety information, including RAMSIS/SUSARs, from other countries where the product is being developed shall be reported only when it implies a change in the benefit-risk profile, within ten (10) administrative business days from becoming aware of it.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de haber tomado conocimiento
deadline_rule.applies_to: Safety information (including SUSARs) from other countries that changes the benefit-risk profile

f.title: Include safety measures taken by other regulatory agencies in foreign safety information submissions
f.statement: The submission must include the safety measures taken by other regulatory agencies that enable ANMAT to apply reliance.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.quote: En la presentación deberán incluirse las medidas de seguridad tomadas por otras agencias regulatorias que posibiliten la aplicación de reliance por parte de ANMAT.
data_elements: safety measures taken by other regulatory agencies
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberán incluirse" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote; quote lacks its lead-in (which submission is meant comes from the preceding paragraph).
rows.quote_en: The submission shall include the safety measures taken by other regulatory agencies that make it possible for ANMAT to apply reliance.

f.title: Break the blind for unexpected SAEs in masked studies following ICH E2A
f.statement: In studies with masked treatment, when the sponsor receives a report of an unexpected serious adverse event it must break the blind following the ICH E2A guideline (Clinical Safety Data Management: definitions and standards for expedited reporting) and its amendments.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: 5.1.6 En los estudios con tratamiento enmascarado cuando el patrocinador reciba un informe de EAS inesperado deberá revelar el ciego siguiendo los lineamientos establecidos en las guías ICH E2A Gestión de datos de seguridad clínica: definiciones y estándares para informes expeditos y sus modificatorias.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "cuando el patrocinador reciba ... deberá revelar el ciego" gives level, actor and trigger explicitly; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 5.1.6 In studies with masked treatment, when the sponsor receives an unexpected SAE report it shall break the blind following the guidelines established in the ICH E2A guidelines Clinical Safety Data Management: definitions and standards for expedited reporting and their amendments.

f.title: Submit an annual DSUR to ANMAT within 90 days of the close of the reporting period
f.statement: Annually from the date ANMAT authorised the first study with the investigational product, the sponsor must submit a Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) evaluating the safety of the investigational medicinal product in light of all available information and listing the ANMAT authorisation file numbers and dispositions related to the product. The report must include what Appendix F requires. The DSUR must be submitted no later than 90 days after the close of the reporting period.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: Annual (from ANMAT authorisation date of the first study with the product); within 90 days of the close of the reporting period
rows.quote: 5.2.1 Con una frecuencia anual a partir de la fecha de autorización de esta Administración del primer estudio con el producto en investigación, el patrocinador debe presentar un informe de actualización sobre seguridad en el desarrollo (DSUR) en el que se evalúe la seguridad del medicamento en investigación teniendo en cuenta toda la información disponible detallando los números de expedientes de autorización y disposiciones de la ANMAT relacionados al producto en investigación. El informe deberá incluir lo mencionado en el apéndice correspondiente (ver apéndice F). El plazo de presentación del Informe de Seguridad (DSUR) no deberá superar los 90 días del cierre del período del reporte.
data_elements: ANMAT dispositions related to the product
rows.review_note: Review: title aligned to source wording ('cierre del período del reporte'); 'debe presentar'/'no deberá superar' = Mandatory; 90 days not qualified as business days in source. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "el patrocinador debe presentar" / "no deberá superar los 90 días" = Mandatory; annual frequency, clock start and 90-day limit explicit in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.2.1 With an annual frequency from the date of this Administration's authorisation of the first study with the investigational product, the sponsor must submit a development safety update report (DSUR) evaluating the safety of the investigational medicinal product taking into account all available information, detailing the authorisation file numbers and ANMAT dispositions related to the investigational product. The report shall include what is mentioned in the corresponding appendix (see Appendix F). The submission deadline for the Safety Report (DSUR) shall not exceed 90 days from the close of the reporting period.

f.title: Inform ANMAT within 10 business days of a finding of increased risks over benefits in any trial with the IMP
f.statement: When, during any trial with the investigational product, an increase in risks over the observed benefits is detected, the sponsor must inform ANMAT within ten (10) administrative business days of the finding, detailing the impact and the measures implemented or to be implemented, as specified in Appendix F.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.deadline: 10 administrative business days from the finding
rows.quote: 5.2.2 Cuando en el transcurso de cualquiera de los ensayos con el producto en investigación se detecte un incremento de los riesgos sobre los beneficios observados, el patrocinador deberá informar a esta Administración en un plazo de diez (10) días hábiles administrativos del hallazgo detallando impacto, medidas implementadas/a implementar acorde a lo especificado en el apéndice correspondiente (ver apéndice F)
data_elements: measures implemented or to be implemented
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "el patrocinador deberá informar ... en un plazo de diez (10) días hábiles administrativos del hallazgo" gives level, actor, deadline and clock start.
rows.quote_en: 5.2.2 When, in the course of any of the trials with the investigational product, an increase in risks over the observed benefits is detected, the sponsor shall inform this Administration within ten (10) administrative business days of the finding, detailing the impact and the measures implemented/to be implemented as specified in the corresponding appendix (see Appendix F)

deadline_rule.clock_start: se detecte un incremento de los riesgos sobre los beneficios observados
deadline_rule.applies_to: Increase in risks over observed benefits detected in any trial with the investigational product

f.title: Review emerging safety information and communicate relevant new data to ANMAT within 10 business days
f.statement: The sponsor must review the emerging safety information available to assess whether there are new data that could affect the participant's willingness to continue in the trial, impact the conduct of the trial, or alter the approval/favourable opinion of the CRI/CEI and/or the regulatory authority. Any such information must be communicated to ANMAT within ten (10) administrative business days.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.quote: 5.2.3 El patrocinador debe revisar la información de seguridad emergente disponible, para evaluar si hay algún dato nuevo que pueda afectar la voluntad del participante de continuar en el ensayo, impactar en la realización del ensayo o alterar la aprobación/opinión favorable del CRI/CEI y/o de la autoridad regulatoria. Toda información de esta naturaleza debe comunicarse a esta Administración en el plazo de diez (10) días hábiles administrativos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; source gives no clock-start for the 10 administrative business days. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "debe revisar"/"debe comunicarse" = Mandatory. Below 90: the 10 administrative business days have no stated clock start, and the second sentence is passive.
rows.quote_en: 5.2.3 The sponsor must review the emerging safety information available to assess whether there are any new data that may affect the participant's willingness to continue in the trial, impact the conduct of the trial, or alter the approval/favourable opinion of the CRI/CEI and/or the regulatory authority. All information of this nature must be communicated to this Administration within ten (10) administrative business days.

f.title: Attach DMC reports to periodic reports; submit within 10 business days when trial conditions or risks change
f.statement: Independent Data Monitoring Committee (CIMD) reports, where applicable, must be attached to the periodic study reports, except when there is a change in the trial's conditions and/or risks, in which case they must be submitted within ten (10) administrative business days of being obtained, as specified in Appendix F.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.exceptions: Where the DMC report reflects a change in conditions and/or risks it is submitted separately within 10 business days.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.deadline: With periodic reports; within 10 administrative business days of receipt if trial conditions or risks change
rows.quote: 5.2.4 Los informes del CIMD, si corresponde, deberán adjuntarse a los informes periódicos del estudio, excepto cuando haya un cambio en las condiciones y/o riesgos del mismo, en cuyo caso deberán presentarse dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles administrativos de obtenido acorde a lo especificado en el apéndice correspondiente (ver apéndice F).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deberán adjuntarse/presentarse" = Mandatory, 10 administrative business days of receipt checked. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.2.4 The CIMD reports, if applicable, shall be attached to the periodic study reports, except when there is a change in its conditions and/or risks, in which case they shall be submitted within ten (10) administrative business days of being obtained as specified in the corresponding appendix (see Appendix F).

f.title: Report serious breaches occurring in Argentina to ANMAT within 10 business days with root cause, impact and CAPA
f.statement: Serious breaches of the authorised protocol, GCP and/or the disposition that occurred in Argentina must be communicated to ANMAT by the sponsor within ten (10) administrative business days from the date it became aware of the breach, as specified in Appendix F. The report must include the description, root-cause analysis, impact and corresponding corrective and preventive actions, considering, where required, suspension of the study at the site.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: 5.3.1 Los incumplimientos graves al protocolo autorizado, a las Buenas Prácticas Clínicas y/o a la presente normativa que hayan ocurrido en Argentina deben ser comunicados a la ANMAT por el patrocinador dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles administrativos a partir de la fecha en que haya tenido conocimiento del incumplimiento, acorde a lo especificado en el apéndice correspondiente (ver apéndice F). Deberá incluirse la descripción, el análisis de la causa raíz, el impacto y las medidas correctivas y preventivas correspondientes contemplando, en caso de requerirse, la suspensión del estudio en el centro.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deben ser comunicados a la ANMAT por el patrocinador dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles administrativos a partir de la fecha en que haya tenido conocimiento" gives level, actor, deadline and clock start.
rows.quote_en: 5.3.1 Serious breaches of the authorised protocol, Good Clinical Practice and/or these rules that have occurred in Argentina must be communicated to ANMAT by the sponsor within ten (10) administrative business days from the date on which it became aware of the breach, as specified in the corresponding appendix (see Appendix F). The description, root-cause analysis, impact and the corresponding corrective and preventive measures shall be included, considering, if required, suspension of the study at the site.

deadline_rule.clock_start: la fecha en que haya tenido conocimiento del incumplimiento
deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious breaches of the protocol, GCP or the regulation that occurred in Argentina

f.title: Justify and communicate the reason for any study suspension or cancellation to the other parties
f.statement: A study may be suspended or cancelled by the investigator, the host institution, the sponsor, the CRI/CEI or ANMAT; in such cases the reason must be justified and communicated to the other parties.
f.clause: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.1
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Party that suspends or cancels the study (investigator, institution, sponsor, CRI/CEI or ANMAT)
rows.quote: 5.5.1 Un estudio puede ser suspendido o cancelado por el investigador, la institución sede, el patrocinador, el CRI/CEI o por esta Administración. En tales casos, el motivo debe justificarse y comunicarse a las demás instancias.
rows.location: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.1
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "puede" (who may suspend) and "debe justificarse y comunicarse" correctly read. Below 90: the duty-bearer is "the party that suspends", an inferred actor in a passive sentence; no deadline.
rows.quote_en: 5.5.1 A study may be suspended or cancelled by the investigator, the host institution, the sponsor, the CRI/CEI or by this Administration. In such cases, the reason must be justified and communicated to the other parties.

f.title: Notify and justify suspension or cancellation of an IMP clinical development to all investigators, institutions and ANMAT
f.statement: If the sponsor suspends or cancels the clinical development of an experimental product, it must notify and justify this to all investigators and host institutions and to ANMAT.
f.clause: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.2
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: 5.5.2 Si el patrocinador suspende o cancela el desarrollo clínico de un producto experimental, debe notificarlo y justificarlo a todos los investigadores e instituciones sedes y a la ANMAT.
rows.location: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "Si el patrocinador suspende o cancela ... debe notificarlo y justificarlo" gives level, actor and trigger; no deadline in the source; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: 5.5.2 If the sponsor suspends or cancels the clinical development of an experimental product, it must notify and justify it to all investigators and host institutions and to ANMAT.

f.title: Notify ANMAT within 10 business days of temporary suspension or early termination of the trial in Argentina
f.statement: In case of temporary suspension of the study or early termination of the trial in Argentina, the sponsor must notify ANMAT within ten (10) administrative business days, communicate the reasons and specify the follow-up measures (Appendix F).
f.clause: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.3
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: 5.5.3 En caso de suspensión temporal del estudio o finalización anticipada del ensayo en el país, el patrocinador deberá notificar dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles administrativos a esta Administración, comunicar los motivos y especificar las medidas de seguimiento (ver apéndice F).
rows.location: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.3
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "el patrocinador deberá notificar dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles administrativos" = Mandatory with explicit actor. Below 90: the 10-day clock start is not stated in the quote.
rows.quote_en: 5.5.3 In case of temporary suspension of the study or early termination of the trial in the country, the sponsor shall notify this Administration within ten (10) administrative business days, communicate the reasons and specify the follow-up measures (see Appendix F).

deadline_rule.clock_start: En caso de suspensión temporal del estudio o finalización anticipada del ensayo en el país
deadline_rule.applies_to: Temporary suspension or early termination of the trial in Argentina

f.title: Inform ANMAT of any change in benefit-risk balance of post-study access medication, by separate procedure
f.statement: The sponsor is obliged to inform ANMAT of any change in the benefit-risk balance related to the medication/treatment used for post-study access. The communication is made by a separate procedure referencing the clinical study authorisation file and the file that authorised post-study provision.
f.applicability: Medication/treatment provided for post-study access after clinical pharmacology studies authorised by ANMAT. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.quote: 6.5 El patrocinador queda sujeto a la obligación de informar a esta ANMAT toda modificación que ocurra en el balance beneficio riesgo relacionado a la medicación /tratamiento utilizado. Dicha comunicación se efectuará por trámite separado debiéndose hacer referencia al expediente de autorización del Estudio Clínico y al que autorizó la provisión post-estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; actor explicit. Below 90: level rests on "queda sujeto a la obligación de informar" (obligation wording, not a modal verb) and no deadline is given.
rows.quote_en: 6.5 The sponsor is subject to the obligation to inform this ANMAT of any modification that occurs in the benefit-risk balance related to the medication/treatment used. Said communication shall be made by a separate procedure, referring to the file of authorisation of the Clinical Study and to the one that authorised the post-study provision.

f.title: Submit the annual safety report with the EFCA form and ICH E2F DSUR content
f.statement: The annual safety report submission must include the corresponding form and attach the information described in ICH E2F (Development Safety Update Report) and its updates.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: F.1.1 En la presentación del informe de seguridad anual se deberá incluir formulario correspondiente y adjuntar con la información descrita en las guías ICH E2F Informe de Actualización de Seguridad del Desarrollo y sus actualizaciones.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "se deberá incluir" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: F.1.1 The submission of the annual safety report shall include the corresponding form and attach the information described in the ICH E2F Development Safety Update Report guidelines and their updates.

f.title: Submit DMC reports on a benefit-risk change with the EFCA form and the DMC report itself
f.statement: The submission of a CIMD (DMC) report due to a change in the benefit-risk balance must include the corresponding form and the CIMD report itself.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.quote: F.1.2 En la presentación de Informe CIMD por cambio en el balance Beneficio Riesgo se deberá incluir el formulario correspondiente y el informe CIMD propiamente dicho.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "se deberá incluir" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: F.1.2 The submission of a CIMD Report due to a change in the Benefit-Risk balance shall include the corresponding form and the CIMD report itself.

f.title: Submit expedited reports with the EFCA form, relevant information and other agencies' safety measures
f.statement: The expedited report submission must include the corresponding form with the relevant information attached, and must also include the safety measures adopted by other regulatory agencies.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations

rows.quote: F.1.3 En la presentación del informe expedito se deberá incluir el formulario correspondiente y adjuntar con la información pertinente. Asimismo, se deberán incluir las medidas de seguridad adoptadas por otras agencias regulatorias.
data_elements: safety measures adopted by other regulatory agencies
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "se deberá(n) incluir" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: F.1.3 The submission of the expedited report shall include the corresponding form and attach the relevant information. Likewise, the safety measures adopted by other regulatory agencies shall be included.

f.title: Submit the EFCA form and a note on reasons and follow-up measures for temporary suspension or early termination
f.statement: In case of temporary suspension of the study or early termination of the trial in Argentina, the corresponding form must be submitted with the report/note detailing the reasons and the follow-up measures.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: F.1.4 En caso de suspensión temporal del estudio o finalización anticipada del ensayo en el país, se deberá presentar el formulario correspondiente con el informe/nota en la que se detallen los motivos y las medidas de seguimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "se deberá presentar" = Mandatory. Below 90: Passive construction, actor (sponsor) inferred from context rather than named in the quote; no deadline in this appendix point (10 days come from 5.5.3).
rows.quote_en: F.1.4 In case of temporary suspension of the study or early termination of the trial in the country, the corresponding form shall be submitted with the report/note detailing the reasons and the follow-up measures.

f.title: Use the EFCA form for annual safety, DMC, expedited and early termination submissions
f.statement: In all the cases of point F.1 (annual safety report, CIMD report, expedited report, early termination/cancellation), the EFCA form for annual safety report, CIMD report or early termination/cancellation must be submitted.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.systems: EFCA form (informe de seguridad anual, informe CIMD, informe expedito o terminación/cancelación temprana)

rows.quote: F.1.5 En todos los casos del punto F.1 se deberá presentar el Formulario EFCA de Informe de seguridad anual, informe CIMD o terminación/cancelación temprana
systems: EFCA form (informe de seguridad anual, informe CIMD, informe expedito o terminación/cancelación temprana)

rows.quote_en: F.1.5 In all the cases of point F.1, the EFCA Form for annual safety report, CIMD report or early termination/cancellation shall be submitted.

f.title: Submit an annual periodic status report per investigator/site to ANMAT
f.statement: The sponsor must submit, as set out in the corresponding section, a periodic report for each investigator with information on the status of the study at the investigator's site, signed and dated by the investigator and the sponsor's representative, at least annually from the date of ANMAT authorisation (see Appendix F).
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: At least annually from the date of ANMAT authorisation
rows.quote: 5.4.1 El patrocinador deberá presentar acorde al apartado correspondiente un informe periódico por cada investigador con información acerca del estado del estudio en su centro, firmado y fechado por el investigador y el representante del patrocinador, con una frecuencia mínima anual a partir de la fecha de autorización de esta Administración (ver apéndice F).
rows.review_note: Review: added in review (5.4 omitted by extractor); periodic site report carries safety content (SAEs non-SUSAR, SUSARs submitted) and receives CIMD reports and administrative amendments. Re-translation: own translation. Double-check: Re-translated here: quote_en faithful; "El patrocinador deberá presentar" = Mandatory, annual frequency from ANMAT authorisation explicit. Statement trimmed: removed the parenthetical on EFCA 5.2 site-form content, which is not in the quote. Below 90: reviewer did not record an independent re-translation (own translation).
rows.quote_en: 5.4.1 The sponsor shall submit, in accordance with the corresponding section, a periodic report for each investigator with information on the status of the study at their site, signed and dated by the investigator and the sponsor's representative, with a minimum annual frequency from the date of authorisation by this Administration (see Appendix F).

f.title: Submit the periodic report within 60 calendar days of the end of the reporting period
f.statement: The periodic report must be submitted no later than 60 calendar days after the close of the reporting period. The reference date for the reporting period is the date of approval of the clinical trial in Argentina.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: Within 60 calendar days after close of the reporting period (periods anchored to the trial's approval date in Argentina)
rows.quote: 5.4.3 El informe periódico deberá ser presentado dentro de los 60 (sesenta) días corridos como máximo luego del cierre del período del informe. Se deberá tomar como referencia la fecha de aprobación del ensayo clínico en Argentina.
rows.review_note: Review: added in review (5.4 omitted by extractor). Re-translation: own translation. rows.quote_en: 5.4.3 The periodic report shall be submitted within a maximum of 60 (sixty) calendar days after the close of the reporting period. The date of approval of the clinical trial in Argentina shall be taken as the reference.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Periodic study status report per investigator

f.title: Notify ANMAT of study completion in Argentina with a complete EFCA 5 final report
f.statement: The sponsor must communicate the end of the study in Argentina by means of a complete EFCA 5 final report form that includes the study end date.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: 5.4.5 El patrocinador deberá comunicar la finalización del estudio en el país a través de un formulario EFCA 5 de informe final completo donde se incluya la fecha de finalización del estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: added in review (5.4 omitted by extractor). Re-translation: own translation. rows.quote_en: 5.4.5 The sponsor shall communicate the completion of the study in the country through a complete EFCA 5 final report form that includes the study completion date.

f.title: Submit the clinical study report with results within 365 calendar days of the last patient's last visit globally
f.statement: The sponsor must submit the clinical study report containing the results within the following year (365 calendar days) after the last visit of the last patient globally.
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: Within 365 calendar days after the last visit of the last patient globally
rows.quote: 5.4.6 El patrocinador deberá presentar el informe de estudio clínico que contenga los resultados dentro del año posterior (365 días corridos) a la última visita del último paciente a nivel global.
rows.review_note: Review: added in review (5.4 omitted by extractor); ICH E3 format per Disp. 4385/2025 is context, not stated here. Re-translation: own translation. rows.quote_en: 5.4.6 The sponsor shall submit the clinical study report containing the results within the year following (365 calendar days) the last visit of the last patient globally.

f.title: Submit a site final report and reasons when a site in Argentina terminates early
f.statement: In case of early termination of the trial at any site that has been initiated in Argentina, the final report for that site must be submitted, whether or not participants were included, and the reasons must be communicated.
f.clause: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.4
f.applicability: Clinical pharmacology studies for registration purposes authorised by ANMAT (Disposición 7516/2025, Annex III; in force from 1 Dec 2025). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: 5.5.4 En caso de finalización anticipada del ensayo en algún centro iniciado en el país, se deberá presentar el informe final correspondiente a ese centro independientemente de la inclusión o no de participantes, y comunicar los motivos.
rows.location: 5.5 Terminación o suspensión prematura de un ensayo, 5.5.4
